title: Page 8
lines: 闻言，绦岚秋蓦地瞪大美眸，「告诉爹爹？」
「对，」封竞天点点头，「你当初嫁我，岳父十分不谅解，不仅婚礼寒酸简陋，就连嫁妆我也不让你多带……」说到这，他忍不住再次暗咒自己的愚蠢，真诚的又说：「加上前些日子的流言，我想岳父肯定十分生气，我定要亲自上门向他请罪。」
他的一番话让绦岚秋感动不已，但她却摇头，「你有这份心就够了，若是可
以，我甚至不想让爹爹知道我曾被休一事，反正那些传言已澄清，他很疼我，就算知道我现在过得幸福，也不见得会原谅你曾经的所作所为，所以……」
「所以更要让他知道！」封竞天打断她的话，满怀愧疚，「错便是错，我欺侮他女儿，让你饱受委屈，这些，都该让他知道，他要怎么责罚我，我都不怨，这是我的过错，我理当承担。」
「但是……」爹爹脾气硬，她不舍他为了她被爹爹责骂。
「岚秋……」他凝视她担忧的神情，哑声说：「你真傻，我这么对你，你不怪我就算了，竟还反过来担心我，你这傻姑娘，我怎会到现在才发现你的好。」
她脸微红，轻咬唇，「我没有你说的那么好。」
她只是爱他胜过爱自己，才会这般担心他。
她的心思封竞天岂会不知，正因为这样，他才会觉得她傻，才会更加悔恨自己浪费的那些时日，他暗自决定，从今日起，他会加倍的爱她，让她感受到无比的幸福，他要将她给宠上天，他会让她知道，他对她的爱，绝不会比她对他的少。
在绦紫嫣与敖允回去绦家的第十天，封竞天终于带着绦岚秋上门拜访。
这趟回去，他可是抱着必死的决心，果然，绦威一见到他便没给他好脸色看，气得七窍生烟，没少给他排头吃。
若不是绦岚秋姊妹俩在一旁缓颊说情，消缓绦威的怒气，他不仅会命人拿扫帚将他给轰出绦府，甚至会下令他永远不准再接近他的宝贝女儿。
虽然在两个女儿的连番说情下，绦威怒气稍减，却没打算这么容易原谅封竞天，他下令，为了惩处他犯下的过错，也当是一段评估期，绦岚秋得搬回绦府住，为期三个月，且两人相见得经过他的允许，否则他休想将他的宝贝女儿带回。
这消息对封竞天可说是青天霹雳，绦威要怎么惩罚他，他都无所谓，但他却严禁自己与绦岚秋会面，这点他可就难以接受，几经争取，绦威仍不肯妥协，为了娶得佳人，最终他只能臭着俊脸，在绦岚秋的软声安慰下独自返家。
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
他现在才知道，没有她的日子有多么难熬，不过才过了几个时辰，他已想她想得快要发狂，想她娇羞的脸蛋、想她甜美的微笑，想她的温柔、她的聪慧及体贴，想她的一切……
今日不过是头一天，他就难受得快要发狂，往后的三个月他该如何度过，偏偏他却无计可施。
「怎么，犯相思了？哈！谁教你这么笨，居然这么久才察觉自个儿爱的人是谁，也难怪绦伯伯要给你这个考验。」
封竞天危险的眯起双眸，回头瞪向倚在门旁、一睑幸灾乐祸的宝贝妹妹。
「封书滢，你很闲是不？」没错，他正在犯相思，因此脾气很不好，这小丫头居然还敢来调侃他？
「是有点。」她又蹦又跳，来到他身旁，笑嘻嘻的又说：「待在府里好无聊哦！哥，明儿个紫嫣回北方，我能不能跟去？」
一听她才刚回来没多久就又想着出门，他不自觉拧起眉，「你回来不过才一个多月，又想着跑出去，你这丫头怎会一点姑娘家的样子也没有？你也学学岚秋，她……」
「停停停——」不用想也知道接下来的训话绝对和老太婆的裹脚布一样，又臭又长，吓得封书滢连忙喊停，求饶地说：「哥……拜托！这是最后一次，等我从北方回来，绝——对会乖乖待在家里……思，一阵子。你也知道，紫嫣就要生宝宝了，人家还没看过小宝宝，你就让我去嘛！好不好？」
「你分明就是贪玩找借口。」他太了解这唯一的妹妹，个性犹如脱缰野马，一刻也闲不住，这回能在府里待上一个月，他已经够欣慰了。
被拆穿了。她吐吐小舌，拉着他的手撒娇道：「我保证定在三个月内回来，你就让我去嘛，哥！」
这丫头！「不是说要看紫嫣的宝宝，三个月她都还没生呢！」
「呃……」封书滢语塞，干脆耍赖，「我不管啦！你要是不让我去，等岚秋回来之后，我一定天天缠着岚秋，让你‘独守空闺’。」
听见她乱用成语，封竞天是既无奈又好笑，摆摆手道：「自个儿小心点，别给他们夫妻俩添麻烦，知道吗？」
目的得逞，她顿时双眼一亮，开心的大喊：「谢谢哥！我这就去准备准备。」
见她和来时一样，又蹦又跳的跑了出去，封竞天除了摇头还是摇头。
真是把这丫头给宠坏了……
三日后，封竞天不管凝姬的苦苦哀求，硬是将人给送出府，甚至还把话说绝，他欠她的人情已还，要是再惹上麻烦，他不会再伸出援手。
这话让凝姬心头憎恨，离去前更是撂下狠话，要他别后悔。
送走凝姬这麻烦，封竞天总算是松了口气，然而才送走一个，后脚又来了一个，让他一张俊颜再次绷得死紧。
「你来做什么？」他极不友善的瞪着来人。
「岚秋呢？」一踏进厅内，邵清凡便四处张望，找寻绦岚秋的身影。
他拧起眉，「她不在。就算在，她也不会见你。」
邵清凡一听，这才将目光看向他。「岚秋见不见我不是由你作主，你究竟把她藏到哪去了？」
他一从苏州回来就去找绦岚秋，没想到早已人去楼空，他直觉认为是封竞天将人给藏起来了，这才匆匆赶来封府。
「谁说我不能作主？」瞪着他的头号情敌，封竞天挑起眉又说：「既然你人都来了，那正好，告诉你一个好消息，一个月后的十五，我将带着岚秋宴请全城百姓，弥补我犯下的过错，你可以当作那场流水席是我和岚秋的喜宴，到时记得早点到。」
邵清凡紧皱双眉，「这话是什么意思？」
「不明白吗？」封竞天十分好心的解释，「也就是说，我们两人已和好如初，那张休书也早已让我给撕个粉碎，扔了。所以，从今以后你最好离我的妻子远一点。」
「这怎么可能！」邵清凡压根不信。绦岚秋受了他这么多的委屈，这才会对封竞天死心搬出封府，她怎么可能会再接纳他！
「信不信随你，总之，别再找岚秋。」他眯起俊眸，危险的警告着。
邵清凡没那么容易死心。「我不信，除非岚秋亲口告诉我。她人呢？我要见她！」
「我说过她不在这！」
封竞天对他的死缠烂打感到不耐，正要唤人送客，却瞥见门外那抹俏丽的倩影，俊颜倏地一沉。
不过才三日，他便想她想到无法自拔，但他本想打发走邵清凡再上绦府找她，没想到她早他一步前来，但却来得不是时候。
甫进门，绦岚秋便看见邵清凡，惊讶的低喊，「邵公子？」
「岚秋？」邵清凡惊喜的回头，「我就知道你在这！」
他正要上前，但封竞天动作更快，早一步来到绦岚秋身旁，占有意味十足的将她紧拥在怀中，不让他近身一步。

Hearing this, Guan Lanqiu's beautiful eyes widened suddenly, "Tell daddy?"
"Yes," Feng Jingtian nodded, "when you married me, my father-in-law was very unforgiving. Not only was the wedding shabby and shabby, I didn't even let you bring more dowry..." At this point, he couldn't help but secretly cursed his stupidity again, and said sincerely: "Coupled with the rumors a few days ago, I think my father-in-law must be very angry, and I will definitely come to him in person to apologize."
His words moved Gui Lanqiu deeply, but she shook her head, "It's enough if you have this heart. If you can
So, I don’t even want my father to know that I was divorced. Anyway, those rumors have been clarified. He loves me very much. Even if he knows that I am living happily now, he may not forgive you for what you did in the past, so..."
"That's why we need to let him know!" Feng Jingtian interrupted her, full of guilt. "Wrong is wrong. I bullied his daughter and made you suffer. He should know all this. No matter how he punishes me, I won't complain. This is my fault and I should bear it."
"But..." Her father has a tough temper, and she doesn't want him to be scolded by her father because of her.
"Lan Qiu..." He stared at her worried expression and said hoarsely: "You are so stupid. I treat you like this, and you don't blame me. Instead, you worry about me instead. You silly girl, how could I not realize how good you are until now."
She blushed slightly and bit her lip, "I'm not as good as you said."
She just loves him more than she loves herself, so she worries about him so much.
How could Feng Jingtian not know what she was thinking? Because of this, he thought she was stupid and regretted the time he wasted even more. He secretly decided that from today on, he would love her twice as much and make her feel extremely happy. He would pamper her to the heavens and let her know that his love for her would never be less than her love for him.
Chapter 10(1)
On the tenth day after Sui Ziyan and Ao Yun returned to Sui's house, Feng Jingtian finally brought Sui Lanqiu for a visit.
He was determined to die this time when he went back. Sure enough, Sui Wei didn't look good on him when he saw him. He was so angry that he gave him a lot of food.
If the two sisters, Sui Lanqiu, had not been interceding to calm Sui Wei's anger, he would have not only ordered someone to blow him out of Sui Wei's house with a broom, but would have even ordered him never to approach his precious daughter again.
Although Sui Wei's anger subsided slightly after his two daughters' repeated intercessions, he had no intention of forgiving Feng Jingtian so easily. He ordered that in order to punish him for the mistakes he had committed, it should also be regarded as an evaluation period. Guan Lanqiu had to move back to Sui Mansion for a period of three months, and the two of them had to get his permission to meet each other, otherwise he would not be able to bring his precious daughter back.
This news was like a thunderbolt for Feng Jingtian. He didn't care how much Sui Wei wanted to punish him, but he strictly prohibited himself from meeting Guan Lanqiu, which he found hard to accept. After several attempts, Sui Wei still refused to compromise. In order to marry a beautiful woman, in the end he could only return home alone with a stinking handsome face and comforted by Gui Lanqiu's soft voice.
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
Only now did he realize how difficult it was to live without her, but after only a few hours, he already missed her so much that he almost went crazy. He missed her shy face, her sweet smile, her gentleness, her intelligence and thoughtfulness, and everything about her...
Today was just the first day, and he felt so uncomfortable that he was about to go crazy. How should he spend the next three months, but he had nothing to do.
"What, are you lovesick? Ha! Who taught you to be so stupid that it took you so long to realize who you loved? No wonder Uncle Sui wants to give you this test."
Feng Jingtian narrowed his eyes dangerously and turned back to glare at his precious sister who was leaning by the door and gloating about his misfortune.
"Feng Shuying, you are very free, aren't you?" Yes, he is lovesick and has a bad temper. How dare this little girl tease him?
"It's a bit." She jumped up and down, came to his side, and said with a smile: "Staying in the house is so boring! Brother, tomorrow Zi Yan returns to the north, can I follow her?"
Hearing that she was thinking about going out not long after she came back, he frowned unconsciously, "You have only been back for more than a month, and you are thinking about running out again. How come you don't look like a girl at all? You should learn from Lan Qiu, she..."
"Stop, stop, stop -" You don't need to think about it to know that the next lecture is definitely the same as the old woman's foot wrap, smelly and long. Feng Shuying was so frightened that she quickly shouted to stop and begged for mercy: "Brother... please! This is the last time. When I come back from the north, I will stay at home... think about it for a while. You also know that Zi Yan is about to give birth to a baby, and she hasn't seen the baby yet, so just let me go! Okay?"
"You are obviously just looking for fun and making excuses." He knew his only sister very well. Her personality was like a wild horse that could not rest for a moment. He was very happy to be able to stay in the house for a month this time.
Exposed. She stuck out her tongue, took his hand and said coquettishly: "I promise to come back within three months, just let me go, brother!"
This girl! "It's not that I want to see Zi Yan's baby. She hasn't given birth yet for three months!"
"Uh..." Feng Shuying was speechless and simply said, "I don't care! If you don't let me go, after Lan Qiu comes back, I will pester Lan Qiu every day and let you stay alone in the empty boudoir."
Hearing her random use of idioms, Feng Jingtian felt helpless and amused. He waved his hands and said, "Be careful and don't cause trouble to the couple, you know?"
Her goal was achieved, her eyes suddenly lit up, and she shouted happily: "Thank you, brother! I'll go get ready right now."
Seeing her running out jumping up and down just like when she came, Feng Jingtian shook his head.
I really spoiled this girl...
Three days later, Feng Jingtian ignored Ning Ji's pleading and sent her out of the house. He even said that he had repaid the favor he owed her and would not lend a helping hand if she got into trouble again.
These words made Ning Ji hate her, and before leaving, she even said harsh words, asking him not to regret it.
Feng Jingtian finally breathed a sigh of relief after sending away Ning Ji's trouble. However, after just sending one away, another one came on the back foot, making his handsome face tense up again.
"What are you doing here?" He glared at the visitor in a very unfriendly manner.
"Where is Lan Qiu?" As soon as he stepped into the hall, Shao Qingfan looked around, looking for Lan Qiu.
He frowned, "She's not here. Even if she were here, she wouldn't see you."
When Shao Qingfan heard this, he looked at him. "It's not up to you whether Lan Qiu sees me or not. Where did you hide her?"
As soon as he came back from Suzhou, he went to look for Guan Lanqiu. Unexpectedly, the building was already empty. He intuitively thought that Feng Jingtian had hidden the person, so he hurried to Feng Mansion.
"Who says I can't make the decision?" Staring at his number one love rival, Feng Jingtian raised his eyebrows and said, "Since you are all here, it's just in time to tell you some good news. On the 15th of a month, I will bring Lan Qiu to a banquet for the people of the city to make up for the mistakes I made. You can consider that flowing water banquet as a wedding banquet for me and Lan Qiu. Remember to arrive early."
Shao Qingfan frowned, "What do you mean by this?"
"Don't you understand?" Feng Jingtian explained very kindly, "In other words, the two of us have reconciled as before, and I have already asked me to tear up the divorce note and throw it away. Therefore, you'd better stay away from my wife from now on."
"How is this possible!" Shao Qingfan didn't believe it at all. Qian Lanqiu had suffered so many grievances from him before she gave up on Feng Jingtian and moved out of Feng Mansion. How could she accept him again?
"Believe it or not, it's up to you. In short, don't look for Lan Qiu again." He narrowed his handsome eyes and warned dangerously.
Shao Qingfan doesn't give up so easily. "I don't believe it unless Lan Qiu tells me personally. Where is she? I want to see her!"
"I told you she's not here!"
Feng Jingtian felt impatient with his persistent pursuit, and was about to call someone to see him off when he caught a glimpse of the pretty figure outside the door, and his handsome face suddenly sank.
It had only been three days, but he already missed her and couldn't help himself. However, he originally wanted to send Shao Qingfan away and go to Sui Mansion to find her, but he didn't expect that she came one step ahead of him, but she came at the wrong time.
As soon as he entered the door, Sui Lanqiu saw Shao Qingfan and shouted in surprise, "Master Shao?"
"Lan Qiu?" Shao Qingfan turned around in surprise, "I knew you were here!"
He was about to step forward, but Feng Jingtian moved faster and came to Gui Lanqiu's side earlier, holding her tightly in his arms possessively, preventing him from getting closer.
